AQI TOWER · WORKING PROJECT NAME · 2 OCTOBER 2026

From idea to a buildable tower

Three preliminary schematics for the first indoor test unit. Outdoor operation remains the final goal.

R00 · NOT FOR FABRICATION OR WIRING. Layout allowances are assumptions. Exact parts, dimensions, structure and electrical protection still need review.

M01-R00 · CONCEPT SECTION · NOT TO SCALE

Round housing, standard filters

A circular exterior can contain standard rectangular filters—but their edges must seal into a full-width partition.

Supplier must approve horizontal filter mounting. Guards, access doors, fasteners and frame members are not detailed here. No weatherproofing implied.

F01-R00 · AIRFLOW AND TEST INSTRUMENTATION

Every cleaning stage must be measurable

ΔP means pressure difference: how much each filter resists airflow. These tap positions are functional, not drilled-hole instructions. Fan static rise is not automatically fan total pressure.

E01-R00 · ELECTRICAL / CONTROL FUNCTIONAL SCHEMATIC

Power and safety separate from the logger

Protection, interlocks and motor control are functional requirements—not a ready-to-wire circuit. Protective earth is not switched. A logger failure must not defeat safety.

Read schematic register and assumptions, mechanical plan, electrical plan and test gates. Revision R00. No parts ordered.
